description: Frontier Desk's dated index of AI-data buyer programs, one row per program: what it buys, the per-company figures and size screens it publishes, its stated payment trigger, exclusivity, de-identification and export method, a verbatim quote from its own page, and the day that page was read. Filter by words found in the program's name, its operator, what it buys or its stated range (every word has to appear), or narrow to the programs that publish a per-company figure. The same rows render at https://www.frontierdesk.ai/data-buyers, with .csv and .json twins.

publishes_a_range.description: true for only the programs that publish a per-company dollar figure; false for only those that do not.

query.description: Words to find in a program's name, operator, what it buys or its stated range, for example "tickets" or "Handshake".

name: search_data_buyers
title: Search the AI-data buyer index
